brief:
Former officials who resigned from President Joe Biden's administration over his Gaza policy are calling on Democratic presidential candidates in the 2028 race to publicly denounce that policy, according to Al-Monitor. The officials, who left their posts in protest, made the appeal on Wednesday as the party prepares for its next cycle of presidential nominations.

The push reflects lingering divisions within Democratic circles over the administration's approach to the Israel-Gaza conflict, with dissident former staffers now seeking to influence the party's future direction on the issue.

title: Ex-Biden officials urge 2028 Democrats to reject Gaza policy
